paper.title: A Machine-Checked Proof for a Translation of Event-B Machines to JML
paper.shortTitle: A Machine-Checked Proof for a Translation of Event-B Machines
paper.authors: Néstor Cataño, Camilo Rueda, Tim Wahls

thesis: We present a machine-checked soundness proof of a translation of Event-B to the Java Modeling Language (JML).

reconstruction.scope: abstract-level graph with retained full text

nodes.title: Research question
nodes.body: How is the reported theorem converted into a machine-checkable proof?

nodes.title: Fix the formal system
nodes.body: The translation is based on an operator EventB2Jml that maps Evnet-B events to JML method specifications, and deterministic and non-deterministic assignments to JML method post-conditions.

nodes.title: Machine-check the proof
nodes.body: This translation has previously been implemented as the EventB2Jml tool.

nodes.title: Primary reported result
nodes.body: Hence, for any Event-B substitution (whether an event or an assignment) and for the JML method specification obtained by applying EventB2Jml to the substitution, we prove that the semantics of the JML method specification is simulated by the semantics of the substitution.

nodes.title: Published conclusion
nodes.body: We present a machine-checked soundness proof of a translation of Event-B to the Java Modeling Language (JML).
